title: relay doctor checks the project of the current folder
what: With no folder argument, `relay doctor` takes the top of the git repository of the current folder; when that folder has relay's project settings (.claude/kit.toml or .relay/), it runs the project checks as `relay doctor <dir>` does, and the output names the project it checked. Outside a project (no git repository, or one without relay's settings) it checks the machine only and says "no project checked". An explicit folder argument works as before.
why: Owner, 27 Oct: "Какой scope у команды relay doctor, глобальный или в случае запуска в директории с .relay добавляются проверки для проекта ?", then picked "A": with no folder given, doctor finds the project the current folder is in and checks it too. Fact that day (bin/relay:505-517): project checks run only with `relay doctor <dir>`; with no argument doctor checks the machine and only relay_tidy reads the current folder, so inside a project it printed "0 to fix" without opening the project's settings. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen); build it together with the fix a-wrong-value-in-project-settings-passes-unnotic, which brings the settings schema these checks use.

fact: Reproduced 30 Oct by the trial on a copy of relay cleaned of relay: `cd proj && relay doctor` printed only '# This machine' (rc 1); the project section appears only with `relay doctor <dir>`, while setup's own closing line says 'Check: relay doctor <dir>'.
